item.title: Kwanzaa: Meaning and traditions
item.description: Dr. Maulana Karenga started Kwanzaa in 1966. His inspiration was to help African Americans honor their African ancestors. He chose December 26th to January 1st for the Kwanzaa holiday. Kwanzaa is a cultural holiday based on harvest festivals in Africa.
